seo.title: Dojo da Luz and Pablo Durán | Aikido Lisbon
seo.description: Discover Dojo da Luz, Pablo Durán and the line of transmission connected to Franck Noël and Tokyo Aikikai.

title: A place to practise the Way.
lead: More than a training room, the dojo is a place of learning, attention and community.
spaceParagraphs: Dojo literally means the place where the Way is practised. It is dedicated to physical, mental and relational development.
Dojo da Luz also includes a social space to read, talk, watch films and spend time together before or after practice.

teacher.label: Teacher
teacher.name: Pablo Durán
paragraphs: He began practising in Jaén in 2002. His search led him to follow Seishiro Endo and meet Franck Noël, who became his main reference.
He lived in Toulouse for six and a half years, practising daily at Dojo de la Roseraie and spending time as an uchideshi. He moved to Lisbon in 2015 and opened Dojo da Luz in 2016.
He continues to attend seminars across Europe and has visited Aikikai Hombu Dojo and Saku Dojo in Japan.

lineage.name: Franck Noël
lineage.text: He practised for eight years in Japan, primarily with Seigo Yamaguchi, and founded Dojo de la Roseraie in Toulouse.

lineage.name: Seigo Yamaguchi
lineage.text: One of the most influential post-war Aikido teachers and a reference for a generation of Japanese and European instructors.

lineage.name: Ueshiba family
lineage.text: Morihei, Kisshomaru and Moriteru Ueshiba have carried the discipline forward from its foundation to the present.
